look: 7 meter armored dinosaur in a low, wide, aggressive crouch, long flat shell of hexagonal bony plates with a jagged serrated snapping-turtle rim, long pale spikes jutting sideways from the flanks and neck, big mean snapping-turtle head with a heavy hooked beak and scowling brow, four short thick splayed legs, thick spiked tail ending in a huge battered spiked bony club, dark slate-grey hide with bone-pale spikes and a sandy club,
texture_prompt: dark slate-grey armor plates with bronze-brown edges, bone-pale spikes and claws, pale cream belly scales, sandy brown tail club, matte surface

clips.attack_primary: TAIL WHIP: armored dinosaur cocks its tail club left and rattles it, stamps, then whips it round behind to the right side while its hind feet step into the swing; the club is the hit
clips.attack_heavy: TAIL SMASH: armored dinosaur steps its front feet out into a brace, raises its club high overhead trembling, then slams it down behind itself; the club is the hit
clips.tail_swipe: CLUB SWEEP: armored dinosaur draws its club far to the left and low, stamps, then sweeps it in one long arc behind itself to the right while pivoting on deliberate steps
clips.knockdown: Armored dinosaur is tipped onto its side
clips.alert: Armored dinosaur lifts its head and lowers its body, the club raised and rattling
clips.sleep: Armored dinosaur settles belly-down with its legs folded out and its tail curled round

pipeline.mesh: Tripo P1 multiview (front, left, back, right), task b55b511f-3cb5-43cf-8d04-ddb3a0d51ea2, 50 Tripo credits
pipeline.reference_sheet: game/assets/creatures/ankylosaurus/ref/ankylosaurus_sheet.png (owner-approved v3 sheet 2026-10-30); left = the v3 side view padded, right = its mirror, front and back drawn by Codex from it
pipeline.transplant_tool: tools/transplant_rig.py --hip-z 0.10 --shoulder-z 0.105 (the side spikes fooled the lateral-surface hip measure)
